@graph.name: 3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura & Ijen Overland from Surabaya to Bali

review.reviewBody: We were happy to join this tour, especially with Pras as our guide and driver. His driving was exceptional—safe, reliable, and always punctual. Despite a tight schedule that often required starting at midnight or early morning, Pras went above and beyond to ensure our comfort, accommodating our requests and making thoughtful arrangements. His cheerful and kind demeanor, combined with excellent English and communication skills, made interactions with local providers seamless. Pras enriched our experience with valuable local insights, ensuring everything ran smoothly. He's the best guide I've ever had, and I truly hope to travel with him again in Indonesia.
